lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd2Ti10B20 (reduced formula NdTi5B10) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 32 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows B centers with 9 geometric neighbors, including B–B and B–Nd contacts, while Nd and Ti centers each have 12 B neighbors, adopting a close-packed-like local arrangement. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate that 12-vertex B and Ti coordination polyhedra exhibit corner-, edge-, and face-sharing patterns.
